name: Maur Raincaller
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Maur Raincaller tends to Mulgore’s herds and wild beasts. He answers concerns tied to the plains’ natural and spiritual life.

sections.title: A Resident of Bloodhoof Village
sections.body: Maur Raincaller lives near the heart of Bloodhoof Village, on Lake Stonebull’s shore. He watches over Mulgore’s wildlife and the balance of the elements. Then the strider Mazzranache bites him and infects his wound. Maur asks young travelers to gather animal parts for a remedy.

faq.answer: Maur Raincaller is a tauren who lives in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He asks travelers to handle unruly wildlife nearby.

faq.q: Where can I find Maur Raincaller?
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller can be found outdoors in Bloodhoof Village, among its tepees and hearth fires. The village lies south of Thunder Bluff, on Lake Stonebull’s eastern bank.

faq.q: What trouble is Maur dealing with?
faq.answer: Mazzranache’s bite leaves Maur Raincaller with an infected wound. He asks travelers to bring parts from Mulgore’s wolves, cougars, plainstriders and swoops so he can make a remedy.

angles.text: As a young tauren leaving Camp Narache, you can help protect your people’s ancestral lands from wandering predators and disruptive beasts.
Maur Raincaller sends you across the plains to hunt wolves, cougars, plainstriders and swoops. He needs their parts to treat the bite Mazzranache gave him.
